caption: The drawing depicts a large brown eagle with outstretched wings perched atop a golden star and a decorative gold scroll set against a background of blue-gray clouds. Behind the eagle and clouds is a bright yellow radiating burst resembling sun rays, spreading outward in all directions. The eagle faces slightly to the left, with its wings partly raised upward and its claws gripping the scroll and star. The gold scroll below the star and eagle contains the phrase “IN TIME OF PEACE PREPARE FOR WAR.” in gold uppercase letters on a black background. The entire composition is centered on a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or designs.
title: Architectural Carving
